Name: Better Junimos performance optimization
Author: sav155
Description:
Hello everyone, I'm a gamer from China. I noticed that some players experience stutters and frame-drops after installing this mod. Specifically, every ten minutes of in-game time the framerate dips (in my case from 60 FPS to 40 FPS for 1–3 seconds).
With the help of an AI assistant I optimized the mod (starting from the author's source code on GitHub).  
Root cause: the larger you set the "working radius" in the config menu, the more blocks the original `SearchHutGrid` double-loop had to scan—its workload grows quadratically, producing the noticeable hitch.
After my patch the drop happens only once, around 6:10 AM, and the rest of the day runs smoothly. Junimos continue to water, fertilize and harvest normally on the farm. (I didn't test the greenhouse since I don't use it, so I can't guarantee they work there.)
I don't know if the author allows this modified version to be uploaded to Nexus, nor how to contact them. If anyone can reach out and ask for permission, I would be very grateful.
Because I used translation software this message may sound a bit stiff, but the bottom line is: the mod will no longer make your game stutter!
Thank you for your attention.

大家好，我是一名来自中国的游戏玩家，我了解到有些人安装了这个mod会导致游戏卡顿、掉帧。具体表现为：游戏时间里每过10分钟，帧率就会下降（对于我来说是从60帧下降到40帧，并且这种状况只持续1-3秒）。于是我借助AI工具优化了这个mod（根据作者github上的源代码修改的）。
导致游戏卡顿的原因：在设置菜单里将工作范围调整的越大，SearchHutGrid 的双层 for 循环扫描地块数量呈平方级上涨，这就是导致掉帧的根源。
经过我的测试，应该只有早上6：10的时候会掉帧1秒，之后的一整天将不再掉帧、卡顿。并且祝尼魔会正常工作。但是祝尼魔在温室里是否会工作我并没有测试，因为我没有温室的需求。总的来说，它在农场里帮你浇水、施肥、收货作物是没有问题的。但是我并不知道作者是否允许我将此版本发布到Nexus上，我也不知道如何联系作者，如果有人能帮忙询问作者的意见。我将不胜感激。
